description: This file defines the ComplexDataInterface, an interface for complex data structures with named and typed properties in Drupal's TypedData API.

classes.name: ComplexDataInterface
classes.description: Interface for complex data structures with named and typed properties in Drupal.

methods.name: getDataDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the data definition object describing the complex data.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a property object by name.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a property value by name, with optional notification control.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns an array of property objects, optionally including computed properties.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all property values as an array.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the data structure is empty.
